prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — shawl (n.披巾，围巾): A broad woven shawl draped over an adult's shoulders and upper arms, soft fringed edge clearly visible.
TOP RIGHT — peer (v.凝视，盯着): An adult peers closely through a small opening in a door with narrowed eyes and intent forward posture.
BOTTOM LEFT — quicken (v.加快): A walker quickens their pace toward a waiting bus, successive steps become longer and closer together, brief motion marks.
BOTTOM RIGHT — rambling (a.杂乱无章的): A rambling old house has an irregular jumble of connected wings, varied roof heights and small additions, building sense rather than a walking person.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: shoulder shawl with fringes, close peering through door opening, quickened approach toward bus, and rambling house with irregular connected wings. Curriculum senses and crop safety verified.
